title: Node.js made by MIRAGE (oasis/node), on BusyBox
author: MIRAGE (node's API in JavaScript); BusyBox from Docker Hub
notes: node made in JavaScript: each node is a process of MIRAGE-LINUX, its script run by the browser's own engine in a Worker, Node's API (fs, process, streams, require, timers) answered by the kernel's system calls (src/node) -- beside the x86 BusyBox shell that starts it, in pipes, on the same files. child_process starts BusyBox's commands, the shell or another node. CommonJS; no network yet.
